speaker: Chris Wright, U.S. Energy Secretary
quote: Nearly 9 million barrels per day leaving through Hormuz, as a seven-day average.
note: Also reported by Reuters commentary of 2026-08-24.

speaker: Chris Wright, U.S. Energy Secretary
quote: About 15 million barrels per day of total regional flow: roughly 9 through Hormuz plus 5-7 via bypass pipelines and export routes.

speaker: U.S. officials
quote: About 10 million barrels per day exiting via the strait itself.

speaker: U.S. officials
quote: 15 to 20 tankers entering and exiting each night in the U.S.-protected corridor.
note: Inbound plus outbound combined; not equivalent to loaded outbound tankers.

quote: A claimed 15 million barrels moved on one particular day.
note: Exceptional single-day volume claim, not an average rate.
